name: Altadena
goal: Revisit the first drill hole in the boxwork unit, at its edge, and compare fresh bedrock with the drilled powder Curiosity analysed.

name: Valle de la Luna
goal: Sample bedrock on the floor of the Monte Grande hollow, then the ridge 10 m away, to test how boxwork ridges and hollows formed.

name: Atacama
goal: Collect the first layered-sulfate bedrock above the boxwork and compare it with the Mineral King drill site 160 m lower.

name: Nazca
goal: Examine a block packed with disc- and needle-shaped crystal forms; their size hints at the temperature, salts and fluids they grew in.
